name: Fintech Indonesia

settings.hero_intro: I've read every post about {{brands}} brands on TikTok, Instagram, Threads and X, and every comment under the posts we track. Ask me about creators, competitors, campaigns or what people say; every number I give you shows its evidence.

note: Fair Listening dump (one CSV per table, workspace_id 1 'FinTech Listening'). The listening 'brand' rows are per-platform handles; they group into seven brands (Refal, 3 Oct 2026: blu by BCA counts as BCA, Shopee stays apart from ShopeePay). A post is owned when its author is one of its brand's handles.
sentiment_map_note: The listening scale is CSAT 1-5; 'average' is CSAT 2, below neutral, so it counts as negative in the three-class view (Refal, 3 Oct 2026). The five-point label and CSAT are kept on every comment.
terms_note: A post is about its brand when the brand posted it, tags one of its accounts, or its caption names the brand: one of its terms or handles at the start of a word. Terms are case-insensitive, except one written in capitals, which matches only in capitals as a whole word ("DANA": lowercase dana is the everyday word for funds). Gojek alone does not count for GoPay (25 posts).
